notes: Rubric v2 (ticket 1171, owner approval 2026-11-26 after the 1170 audit). v1 is docs/measure/rubric-v1.md. Nothing was loosened.

Rule: a figure that was not measured the way the rubric names scores 0 (it is shown as a floor), and a check that rests on a test counts only when that test ran green in this run. Reason: v1 passed checks on 'a test exists' and measured an empty app.

Usability, Feature cohesion, First use: every cell is driven and timed in the running app on one path rule (the default GUI path); the task score is the lower of the step score and the time score; First use starts at the download page. Reason: v1 counted steps from code, ours on the best path and the peers' on the default path.

Speed: the warm launch is the restored launch (20 sessions and a 5,000-event conversation), 100 at 0.3 s (herdr 0.28 s), 0 at 1.5 s (T3 Code 1.39 s measured); cold launch 0 at 3.5 s (T3 Code's first launch); terminal key to paint p95 (16 ms = 100, 50 ms = 0) replaces send to agent. Reason: every local socket scored 100 on 'send', and the one speed target we fail was not in the part.

Optimization: idle memory and CPU at 5 real agent sessions with holders, 150..600 MiB and 0.3..3 %. Reason: v1's zero point was Orca's RSS in use (its footprint measured 521 MiB idle on 11-26) against our empty app, and holders were not counted.

Agent compatibility, Integrations, Extensibility, Bot and team: rows against the best peer plus breadth counts on a log scale; an ACP agent counts only with a real agent turn. Reason: all apps scored the same on yes/no rows.
Stability: field figures over 7 days (seats lost per restart, missed prompts per 1,000) and a 24 h soak with 20 real sessions replace 10 launches of an empty app and 100 idle shells.
New parts p33 Real-use speed and weight, p34 Multi-agent accuracy, p35 Bot quality, p36 Extensibility for others, p37 Reach: the audit's five blind spots.

First official v2 run (fresh judge, 2026-11-26, main c5cd98879, worktree measure-v2): run, tests, dev, ops, page; NUNCHIRO_* unset; MEASURE_MAINWATCH = <main checkout>/.scratch/fable/ci-mainwatch.log (read only). Every verdict and every Nunchiro cell of p01, p06, p16, p22, p36 re-read with file:line at c5cd98879.
